_comment: Golden cross-language fixture for lic_blob_t (OLS-14). Shared by the TS test (license-blob.test.ts) and the C host-test (T04). 'input' is the structured license; 'expectedBytesHex' is the deterministic 106-byte LE serialization produced by serializeLicenseBlob; 'expectedCrc32' is CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over [payload||signature] (offsets 0..101). Any byte here MUST match both the TS serializer and the C memcpy of the packed struct. Do not hand-edit expectedBytesHex.
